# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 18 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 18 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_018_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 18

**18:1** He found a cave nearby and brought her into it. He left his sons with her to watch over her and went out to look for a Hebrew midwife in the region of Bethlehem.

**18:2** And I, Joseph, was walking — and yet I was not walking. I looked up to the canopy of heaven and saw that it was standing still. I looked at the air and saw the air in a state of astonishment. I looked at the birds of the sky, and they were frozen in place. I looked down at the ground and saw a bowl lying there, with workers reclining beside it, their hands resting in the bowl. Those who were eating were not eating. Those who were lifting something were not lifting it. Those who were carrying food to their mouths were not raising it. And every face was turned upward.

**18:3** I saw a flock of sheep being driven along, and they stood motionless. The shepherd had his hand raised to strike them, but the hand stayed raised and did not fall. I saw a stream of water and the mouths of the goat-kids bent down toward the surface — yet they were not drinking. And then in a single instant everything resumed its course.

**18:4** And behold, a woman came down from the hill country and said to me: "Where are you going, friend?" I said: "I am looking for a Hebrew midwife." She replied: "Are you of Israel?" I said: "Yes." She asked: "And who is the woman laboring in the cave?" I said: "She is my betrothed." She asked: "Is she not your wife?" I replied: "She is Mary, who was brought up in the temple of the Lord. I received her by lot as a wife, but she is not truly my wife — she has conceived by the Holy Spirit."

**18:5** The midwife said: "Is this true?" And Joseph said: "Come and see." And the midwife went with him.
